svg.aria-label: System view of the method: per-group encoders map group-specific inputs into a shared latent space with learnt class anchors, a single head predicts for all groups, alignment and separation losses shape the latent space, and group weights driven by each group's excess loss over an offline reference feed the weighted training objective.
